title: Gate and visitors
lede: Gates, tablets, guards, each house's rule and the estate's entry log

noProperty.title: No estate yet
noProperty.body: Add the estate and its buildings first, then set up its gates.

gates.lede: Each gate has its guards' tablet and may drive a barrier and a plate camera (LPR) through the estate's gateway.
gates.name: Gate name
gates.nameHint: What guards and residents see, e.g. Gate 1 · Main entrance

empty.title: No gates yet
empty.body: Add the first gate, then create a registration code for the guards' tablet.

gates.noTablets: No tablet yet. Create a registration code to start.
gates.noHardwareLede: No barrier or LPR camera connected to this gate.
gates.tabletHint: On the tablet, open getproperty's {url} and enter the registration code.
gates.newTabletLede: A one-time registration code is created and shown once.
gates.codeLede: Write it down or copy it now. It is not shown again once this window closes.
gates.codeStep1: On the tablet, open getproperty's /gate page
gates.codeStep2: Enter this code and tap Register tablet
gates.codeStep3: Guards pick their name and enter their PIN to start a shift
gates.codeOnce: The code works once, within the time the system allows. If it is lost, create a new one.
gates.revokeTabletBody: Any shift open on this tablet ends at once. It needs a new code to work again.
gates.attachTitle: Connect a barrier or LPR camera
gates.attachLede: Devices connect through the estate's gateway; a channel cannot be used twice on one gateway.
gates.edgeHint: A gateway installed at this estate
gates.channelInvalid: Letters, digits and _ . : - only, up to 32
gates.pulseHint: Leave empty for the estate's value
gates.detachBody: The gate can no longer open the barrier or read plates with this device.

guards.lede: Guards sign in with their name and PIN on the gate's tablet only; they cannot sign in anywhere else.

empty.title: No guards yet
empty.body: Add each guard's name and PIN.

guards.addLede: Tell the guard the PIN yourself; it is not shown again.
guards.name: Display name
guards.nameHint: The name the guard taps on the tablet
guards.resetPinLede: Also unlocks a guard locked by wrong PINs.
guards.revokeBody: Any open shift ends at once and the guard cannot start one again.

policies.lede: Each house sets how long it has to answer and what the guard does if nobody does.

none.title: Choose a house on the left
none.body: See and change its rule. Houses without one use the estate's.

policies.noteHint: e.g. there is a dog · up to 300 characters

blacklist.lede: A plate on this list is refused at once. Every addition or removal needs a reason and is recorded.

empty.title: No blacklisted plates
empty.body: Add a plate only with a resolution or a clear reason.

blacklist.addLede: Guards see that the plate is refused, not why.
blacklist.reasonHint: At least 5 characters, e.g. the resolution
blacklist.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 5 characters
blacklist.revokeBody: The plate enters as usual again. Give the reason for the record.

invites.lede: Contractors a house invites need the office's approval before their QR works.

empty.title: No invites waiting
empty.body: When a house invites a contractor, it shows here.

invites.approveBody: {name} can enter with the QR within the house's window.
invites.rejectBody: The house is told, with the reason if you give one.

reason.lede: This log holds personal data. Every opening is recorded with your reason and your name.
reason.label: Why you are opening it
reason.placeholder: e.g. house 99/11 asked about a car yesterday

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.body: Try other filters. Records older than the estate keeps them are deleted.

empty.title: No incidents in this period
empty.body: When a resident or a guard raises an SOS it shows here.

incident.visitsLede: Vehicles in before the SOS and not out, or out shortly before it, as the system counts them.
incident.acknowledgeBody: The reporter sees that the office has it.

vehicles.lede: Cars households register in the LINE app. The LPR camera lets them in without asking. Read-only for the office.

empty.title: No registered cars
empty.body: Residents add their household's cars in the LINE app.

settings.retention: How long visitor records are kept
settings.retentionHint: Photos, plates, names and the last 4 ID digits are deleted when the time is up · in force since {since} · set by the platform under data protection law

group.hardware: Barrier, LPR camera and opening from LINE
